SMTO-SYS-0001 — Unexpected internal error

GUID: 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
Slug: unexpected-internal-error
Domain: SYS · Subsystem: runtime

What happened

  • Something went wrong inside SMTO while it was handling your request. This message does not tell us what caused the problem, or whether your action finished.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Check whether your action already happened. For example, look for the saved change, the sent message or the finished file. Repeating an action that already finished could do it twice.
  2. Only if it didn't happen, try it once more. If you can't tell, ask the person who manages SMTO to check first. This message does not establish what completed, so checking first avoids doing the work twice.
  3. Select Copy error details in this panel and send them to the person who manages SMTO. The error reference lets them find this exact failure in SMTO's logs without seeing your task content.

What success looks like

  • You've confirmed whether the action finished, and the feature works when you use it again.

If it still fails

  • There is no confirmed quick fix for this message alone. Keep the copied error details for the person investigating, and don't change settings or delete SMTO's data to guess at a fix.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • SMTO encountered an unexpected internal failure.

What this means

  • The failure reached a reporting boundary without a recognized, more specific diagnostic. Its underlying cause is not established. The occurrence ID, stage and retained receipts are the evidence for investigation; this category does not show whether earlier external work completed.

Why this can happen

  • No supported cause identity was available at this reporting boundary. The underlying defect remains unknown.

How to diagnose it

  • Preserve the occurrence ID, stage and sanitized technical detail. Compare operation receipts and current target state if work may have been dispatched; report those references to support without including secrets or task content.

How to fix it

  • No direct repair is available for this occurrence. Use the supported investigation or alternative workflow below.
  • This is the resolver's reserved fallback (src/error_catalog/resolver.py) when no specific error identity, typed reason or retained cause resolved. Use the Error ID and occurrence ID to find the original exception and stage in the Server log, inspect current task and receipt state before repeating work, and report the defect with sanitized diagnostics. Do not invent a configuration change.

Retry and execution caution

  • The outcome cannot establish safe replay. Inspect current state and preserve the occurrence ID before another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • No fix verification applies. Retain the original outcome and follow the stated inspection or support guidance.

What not to do

  • Do not delete evidence or invent a configuration change for an unexplained internal failure.

Technical notes

  • Reserved fallback when no explicit identity, typed reason or retained cause resolves; no execution outcome is inferred.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
